objective: Resolve the fixed provider declaration through Runstead's existing OpenAI-compatible path, prove the explicit external secret reference is available, and make at most one authenticated exact-model control request.
allowed_effects: one authenticated exact-model control request after all preflight checks pass
prohibited_effects: model sweep or alternate model selection
fallback, rotation, quota probing, or extra control requests
credential value or derivation in output, logs, repository, or state
stop_conditions: any required preflight boolean is false
provider declaration does not resolve exactly
the exact model control fails or its response cannot be safely classified
